'''Kureo Yuge''' (弓削 是雄) was a {{ill|Nobility|en|Nobility|qid=Q134737|lt=noble}} and {{ill|Onmyōji|en|Onmyōji|qid=Q2274163|lt=onmyōji}} of the {{ill|Heian period|en|Heian period|qid=Q193292|lt=Early Heian period}}. He held the title {{ill|Junior Fifth Rank|ja|従五位下|lt=Junior Fifth Rank, Lower Grade}} and served as Chief of the {{ill|Yin-Yang Bureau|ja|陰陽寮|en:draft|Yin-Yang Bureau|lt=Yin-Yang Bureau}}. He was the son of {{ill|Yuge Yasuto|ja|弓削安人}}.

== Career ==
Kureo began his service in the Bureau of Onmyō (陰陽寮) during the reign of {{ill|Emperor Seiwa|ja|Emperor Seiwa}}, working as an onmyōji. In {{ill|Zhenguan|en|Zhenguan|qid=Q3577278|lt=Jōgan}} 6 ({{ill|864|en|864|qid=Q25041|lt=864}}), he and his father moved their {{ill|Korean clans|en|Korean clans|qid=Q846706|lt=honke}} from {{ill|Harima Province|en|Harima Province|qid=Q1047523|lt=Harima Province}} to {{ill|Kawachi Province|en|Kawachi Province|qid=Q1047150|lt=Kawachi Province}}.<ref>At the time, Kureo held the Rank of {{ill|Junior Eighth Rank|ja|従八位下|lt=Junior Eighth Rank, Lower Grade}}.</ref>

During Emperor Seiwa’s later reign, he continued in various roles within the Bureau of Onmyō. By {{ill|Zhenguan|en|Zhenguan|qid=Q3577278|lt=Jōgan}} 15 ({{ill|873|en|873|qid=Q30369|lt=873}}), he relocated his honke again to {{ill|Ukyo Sanjō Second Ward|ja|右京三条二坊}}. In {{ill|Zhenguan|en|Zhenguan|qid=Q3577278|lt=Jōgan}} 19 ({{ill|877|en|877|qid=Q23905|lt=877}}), upon {{ill|Emperor Yōzei|en|Emperor Yōzei|qid=Q349280|lt=Emperor Yōzei}}'s accession, he was promoted to {{ill|Junior Fifth Rank|ja|従五位下|lt=Junior Fifth Rank, Lower Grade}}, and his clan's name was changed from "Ren" (連) to "Sukune" (宿禰).<ref>『日本三代実録』Jōgan 19 (877), April 1 entry.</ref>

In {{ill|Ninna|en|Ninna|qid=Q1346317|lt=Ninna}} 1 ({{ill|885|en|885|qid=Q24894|lt=885}}), he became Chief of the {{ill|Yin-Yang Bureau|ja|陰陽寮|en:draft|Yin-Yang Bureau|lt=Yin-Yang Bureau}}. A record suggests he passed away in {{ill|Engi (era)|en|Engi (era)|qid=Q1374325|lt=Engi}} 8 ({{ill|908|en|908|qid=Q30463|lt=908}}) at the age of 61.

== Folklore ==
Kureo was reputed for his divination skills. A story in the {{ill|Konjaku Monogatarishū|en|Konjaku Monogatarishū|qid=Q1507085|lt=Konjaku Monogatari}} recounts his dream interpretation that saved a man's life.<ref>『今昔物語集』巻24第14話 "天文博士弓削是男占夢語".</ref>

In this tale, Kureo warns his fellow traveler, Ban no Tsugutsugu, against returning home due to a prophetic dream. Kureo instructs Tsugutsugu on how to confront the danger. Following the advice, Tsugutsugu discovers an assassin hidden in his house and averts his fate, confirming Kureo’s prophetic prowess.

== Official Positions ==
All details are from the {{ill|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|en|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|qid=Q1052981|lt=Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku}} unless noted otherwise:
* Undated: {{ill|Junior Eighth Rank|ja|従八位下|lt=Junior Eighth Rank, Lower Grade}}, Onmyōji
* Jōgan 6 (864): Honke moved from Harima Province to Kawachi Province
* Undated: {{ill|Senior Seventh Rank|ja|正七位上|lt=Senior Seventh Rank, Upper Grade}}, Onmyō Assistant
* Jōgan 15 (873): Honke moved to Ukyo Sanjō Second Ward
* Undated: {{ill|Senior Sixth Rank|ja|正六位上|lt=Senior Sixth Rank, Upper Grade}}, Onmyō Subordinate
* Jōgan 19 (877): Promoted to {{ill|Junior Fifth Rank|ja|従五位下|lt=Junior Fifth Rank, Lower Grade}} (Outer). Clan name changed to Sukune
* Undated: Assistant in Bizen Province
* Genkei 6 (882): Promoted to Junior Fifth Rank (Inner)
* Ninna 1 (885): Appointed Chief of the Bureau of Onmyō
* Engi 8 (908): Passed away<ref name="skf" />
